messages:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can we clarify the delivery windows and blockers for the API, Console, and Optimize items that were called out? Trying to line up customer comms and release notes.

maria: TL;DR: we have staggered waves. API infra + streaming tweaks = ~6 weeks. Console route-level dashboards + rollout controls = ~10 weeks. Optimize initial recommendations (batching + quant profiles) = ~12 weeks. These are target windows not hard dates. :spiral_calendar:

kevin: Note on blockers — runtime work to support streaming partial responses while preserving KV cache efficiency is the main technical dependency for API changes. Also need kernel selection testing for quant profiles before Optimize.

nidhi: Can you clarify rollout plan? Will API changes roll to Hosted first then Dedicated/Private? Any compatibility guarantees for customers pinned to older model builds?

maria: Hosted first (canary -> open beta -> GA), then Dedicated customers via opt-in reserved pools, Private as an upgrade package. We'll keep model pinning supported; fallback routing will be used if kernel mismatch is detected.

sam: Docs/SDK question — do we freeze public SDKs until streaming semantics are finalized or release a beta flag?

kevin: We should ship an opt-in SDK flag for streaming/batching behaviour so early users can test without breaking the default. Avoid any breaking signature changes.

emily: Release cadence: canary for the API tweaks starts next Tuesday (ops has a window). Console canary 3 weeks after that. Optimize experimental rollout planned for a small set of internal + partner customers ~8 weeks from now. Will post a release checklist and owners.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window scheduled: 2234660000 - tags: api-streaming-canary, console-dashboard-smoke. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/2234660000

nidhi: For acceptance criteria, can we make the gating explicit? e.g., latency regressions <5% at p95, no increase in tail errors, metrics for per-route cost delta, and an eval run on our canonical prompt-set.

kevin: Agree — we'll add automated evals to the canary pipeline. Also adding model-variant fallback in the routing layer if quantization causes divergence > threshold.

maria: I'll draft a short follow-up doc with timelines, owners, and the gating matrix by EOD tomorrow and share the board. Will call out which customers we'll invite to the Optimize preview.

emily: Owners so far: API = kevin (eng), Console = sam (devex/product eng), Optimize = nidhi (product). I'm the release DRI. I'll update the releases board and tag action items.

jordan: Perfect — thanks. I'll wait for the doc and then prepare a short customer-facing blurb. Please @mention me when it's posted. Reminder: sync next Wed to triage any new risks. :thumbsup:
